column3: Given on Lease
In this section, “Head of Office”—
when used with reference to a member of any Unit
of the Sri Lanka Army, Sri Lanka Navy or Sri Lanka
Air Force, means the Commanding Officer of that
Unit;
when used with reference to a person employed in a
Provincial  Council,  means  the  Secretary  of  that
Provincial  Council;
when used with reference to a person employed in
the Provincial Public Service, means the Head of
the Department in which such person is employed;
when used with reference to a person employed in a
local authority, if the local authority is a Municipal
Council,  means  the  Municipal  Commissioner  of
such Municipal Council and if the local authority
is an Urban Council or a Pradeshiya Sabha, means
the Chairman or Secretary of such Council or Sabha;
and
when used with reference to any other public officer,
means  the  Head  of  the  Department  of  the
Government in which such person is employed.
